audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Steadfast Presence stops Tumble. It appears once, buried in wants.foe[1] as 'Her W to negate your dash'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Poppy 'can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.' Tumble is Vayne's only mobility, and the whole page's advice is 'kite with Q tumble'. Her W on 20/18/16/14/12s deletes that plan on demand.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence stops Tumble mid-dash and then slows and grounds you — kite on foot while her 20s W is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict is described only as a knockback; that it is a channel goes unsaid.
audit.why: The kit flags it channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it') and untargetable. Condemn cancels the 140/120/100s ultimate outright — the single highest-value use of a 20s spell in this matchup — and dumping burst into the untargetable window wastes it instead.
audit.corrected: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — Condemn cancels it outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Vayne, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Vayne, Poppy, Poppy in both layers; the packet chart and every corresponding why say Vayne at rows 1, 2, 5 and 6.
audit.why: whys[1], whys[2], whys[5] and whys[6] all describe Vayne winning those rows, and the audited Poppy side was realigned to the packet chart. Poppy's real window is level 4-5, when Heroic Charge is up and wall stuns are live.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5, 6 to Vayne as one atomic paired group with ratings moved to match; row 3 stays Poppy.

audit.why: Four spikes present and staged correctly; her level-4 Heroic Charge window and Vayne's Blade of the Ruined King timing are both named, and the ratings now follow the chart.

edits.before: Final Hour swings it back: stealth and Tumble resets let you dodge Heroic Charge and her Keeper's Verdict knockback, then punish with Silver Bolts.
edits.after: Final Hour swings it back: faster Tumbles and stealth punish her charge, but Steadfast Presence stops a Tumble mid-dash — kite on foot while her 20s W is up.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Poppy's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack or ability on one target — Condemn advances the stack.

edits.before: Poppy wastes Heroic Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Heroic Charge dashes 475 and is 14s at rank 1 — punish the miss.

edits.before: That is Poppy's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops your Tumble outright, then slows and grounds you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — Condemn cancels it outright.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: Wall-pin stun. Tumble out of it. When it is down — W-shred + kite her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops Tumble mid-dash, so kite on foot; Heroic Charge stuns only into a wall.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Tumble out of it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence: 20s at rank 1 — it stops Tumble mid-dash, then slows and grounds you. - Heroic Charge: 14s, 475 range, stuns only into a wall. - Keeper's Verdict: 140s channel Condemn cancels.

notes: dosFull[0].d still says 'Tumble out of it' about Heroic Charge — that advice is actively wrong while Steadfast Presence is up, but the string is only 70 characters and the honest replacement does not fit the band without losing the Do's own point. Flagged rather than half-fixed. Also: the kit tags Hammer Shock with grounding, while Riot's description mentions only a slowing zone that explodes — I wrote nothing that depends on Q grounding.
